name: m/place
tagline: 1 mayo = 1 pixel. Paint the office canvas, ban the trolls.
description: The office pixel canvas, bufo edition: pick a colour at a paint bucket and paint the ghost image pixel by pixel, one mayo each. Mayo jars refill you, and troll bufos scribble over your art until you splat them with mayo.
win_text: The canvas matches! 1 mayo = 1 pixel, well spent.
lose_text: Not enough mayo left for the pixels still wrong.
